profile_summary: Full-Stack Java Developer with 2 years of experience owning applications end to end Spring Boot REST APIs, React 18 admin UIs, and AWS infrastructure. Built 8 custom enterprise applications with 5 production go-lives on a SAP S/4HANA-integrated warehouse platform. Strong in Spring Security/JWT, PostgreSQL, Redis, CloudFormation, and CI/CD. Prior Android (Kotlin) experience.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack: Java/Spring Boot + React)
bullets: Built 8 custom applications with 5 production go-lives for clients, owning design, coding, testing, UAT, and deployment.
Developed 37+ REST APIs across 5 backend modules on Spring Boot (pick confirmation, putaway, returns, goods movement, inventory), secured with Spring Security role-based access.

Built a React 18 + Material UI admin SPA for multi-tenant warehouse clients: login, clients, portal/SAP users, S/4 tasks, and activity logs, with 3 roles (Administrator, Super User, User) enforced by route guards and per-role write rules.
Implemented server-paged task and log screens (debounced search, sort, filters) with in-browser Excel export.
Built one Axios client: bearer token, JWT expiry check at startup, login lockout (5 failures / 15 min), and mapped 409/429 errors Vite proxy to the Spring Boot API.

Integrated with SAP S/4HANA (serial-assignment and barcode-template APIs) replaced silent HTTP 200 failures with proper error propagation. Maintained an Apache Camel REST↔SOAP layer and RabbitMQ consumer fixed a Camel race condition.
Built a multi-tenant log analytics service (JWT, PostgreSQL, tenant routing, rate limiting) with Liquibase and JUnit.

Designed AWS architecture per client (EC2, ALB, RDS, Route 53, S3, IAM) with CloudFormation, cutting provisioning from 4--6 hrs to 15--20 min wrote Lambda + scheduler functions to auto start/stop EC2 and RDS for cost savings built CI/CD pipelines on AWS and Azure DevOps.
Earlier mobile work: shipped Android clients (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, ML Kit) for this platform.

experience.title: Backend Intern
bullets: Built Spring Boot REST APIs with role-based access control across 3 roles optimised MySQL queries, cutting API response time by 40 ms.

projects.name: Social Platform API
bullets: Designed a Spring Boot backend (feed, stories, comments, chat, notifications, call signaling) with JWT access/refresh tokens, Redis rate limiting, and login lockout.
Used Redis Streams to batch-persist likes to PostgreSQL added S3 presigned uploads, FCM push, and Docker.

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, ALB, Route 53, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, EventBridge, CloudFormation)
